finding: Ceiling-sized five-row partitions at n=513, 128 ranks are not clamped to empty when start_row exceeds n. Ranks 103 through 127 compute unsigned local_rows=n-start_row, which underflows, then construct local_col_k with an impossible length. The receive-count calculation repeats the same defect.
observed_failure: Multiple ranks throw std::length_error: cannot create std::vector larger than max_size(), and the job exits 134. The paired Fable r5 case passes in 19.61 seconds.
interpretation: Deterministic empty-partition underflow, not resource pressure or timeout. The effective-source change is only maximum-rank timing reporting. Retain failed external validation without retry.
investigation: Static source inspection, original/effective diff and retained validation output; no new program execution.
